processes.name: Extend or create a deal for meter flow with no deal
processes.description: Allocation exceptions show gas flowing at a meter after a Sitara deal expired or with no deal; logistics ask for the deal to be extended, rolled or newly set up so volume management can allocate. Requests often need correction or follow-up, and flow is sometimes parked on stranger's gas meanwhile.
processes.trigger: allocation exception or flow at a meter outside the deal dates
processes.output: extended, rolled or new deal covering the flow

automation.idea: a standard deal-extension request that is pre-filled from the allocation exception line, with meter, deal number and dates
automation.why: the same request is typed by hand for each meter

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up the expired deal and dates and writing the extension request

processes.name: Accounting arrangement and meter reallocation
processes.description: Logistics ask for accounting arrangements, tracking IDs and a reallocation of a meter so production is paid or billed correctly. Deal numbers are sometimes wrong and need correcting.
processes.trigger: production at a meter with no accounting arrangement or wrong contract
processes.output: accounting arrangement with tracking ID and reallocated meter

automation.idea: a checklist of what volume management needs for an accounting arrangement
automation.why: requests miss the contract, deal number or dates and bounce back

minutes_per_event.rationale: gathering deal and contract details and writing the request

processes.name: Stranger's gas and unattached meter volume resolution
processes.description: Volume booked to the strangers gas contract with no deal is reviewed and either attached to a deal or approved for write-off to unaccounted-for gas. Several meters wait on replies and follow-ups.
processes.trigger: volume on the strangers gas contract or a meter with no deal
processes.output: deal for the volume or approved write-off

automation.idea: a standard write-off or attach-deal request listing meter, month, volume and expired deal
automation.why: each meter request repeats the same fields and choices

minutes_per_event.rationale: researching the meter and drafting the request

processes.name: Counterparty daily and monthly nomination files
processes.description: Counterparties such as Calpine, TXU and Reliant send daily or monthly gas nomination files by email, usually after a phone call, for the desk to load.
processes.trigger: counterparty nomination due for the gas day or month

automation.idea: a shared intake mailbox rule that files nomination attachments and acknowledges them
automation.why: attachments are handled one by one

minutes_per_event.rationale: opening, checking and filing the nomination attachment

processes.name: Plant monthly nomination submission
processes.description: Monthly natural gas nominations for the Methanol and MTBE plants and ranch setups are submitted and sometimes revised.
processes.trigger: start of a new month or a change in plant takes

automation.idea: a monthly nomination checklist with last month's volumes pre-filled
automation.why: revisions come from missed details

minutes_per_event.rationale: preparing figures and sending the nomination or revision

processes.name: HL&P flow numbers reporting
processes.description: Flow numbers for HL&P are sent to the commercial contact on request, daily or monthly, with corrected versions when wrong.
processes.trigger: request for latest HL&P numbers

automation.idea: a standard report email built from the latest numbers
automation.why: the same file is sent repeatedly

minutes_per_event.rationale: pulling the latest numbers and sending

processes.name: Daily flow and volume change notices
processes.description: Producers and customers change nominated volumes at wells and meters; the desk updates nominations and confirmations.
processes.trigger: producer or customer volume change

automation.idea: a standard volume-change request form
automation.why: changes arrive in free text

minutes_per_event.rationale: reading the change and updating nominations

processes.name: Meter shut-in and restoration notices
processes.description: Field staff shut in meters for leaks, off-spec gas or work, notify groups and later restore service.
processes.trigger: leak, dew point problem or planned work
processes.output: meter shut in or restored and notice sent

automation.idea: a standard shut-in notice for affected groups
automation.why: each notice repeats the same details

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the notice and updating volumes

processes.name: New production Sitara ticket setup
processes.description: Spot or committed reserves tickets in Sitara are created when new wells flow; the committed reserves ticket waits for reserve forecasts.
processes.trigger: new well or production flowing
processes.output: Sitara spot or committed reserves ticket

automation.idea: a new-well ticket request with required fields
automation.why: requests arrive with fields missing

minutes_per_event.rationale: collecting terms and keying the ticket

processes.name: Out-of-office coverage hand-off
processes.description: People announce absences and name backups for scheduling, confirmations and questions.
processes.trigger: planned absence

automation.idea: an absence notice with duties and backups
automation.why: the notice is rewritten every time

minutes_per_event.rationale: listing duties and backups

processes.name: Transport usage ticket and rate maintenance
processes.description: Monthly transport usage tickets are updated and rates checked against matrices; missing service rates are cleared.
processes.trigger: new month or missing-rates report

automation.idea: a month-start checklist for ticket and rate updates
automation.why: steps and rate sources are repeated each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: updating rates and volumes across tickets

processes.name: Interconnect and pipeline volume variance reconciliation
processes.description: Volumes are compared with pipelines such as PG&E and Oasis and intercompany deals; variances are researched and corrected, often with waiting on others.
processes.trigger: variance report or invoice difference

automation.idea: an automatic variance list by day and contract
automation.why: matching is done by hand

minutes_per_event.rationale: comparing figures and chasing the correct side

processes.name: UA4 unaccounted-for volume resolution
processes.description: Unallocated or unaccounted volumes are researched across contracts and prior months to assign deals or adjust.
processes.trigger: UA4 report or unallocated volume

automation.idea: a research checklist for old unallocated meters
automation.why: the same lookups repeat

minutes_per_event.rationale: researching prior months

processes.name: Counterparty invoice and price discrepancy check
processes.description: Counterparties dispute prices or invoices versus Sitara; staff check deal records and correct or confirm, with escalation when unresolved.
processes.trigger: counterparty invoice or price query

automation.idea: a discrepancy check template with deal, invoice and Sitara price
automation.why: each query repeats the lookup

minutes_per_event.rationale: finding deal and invoice and confirming the price

processes.name: OPM hours and activity survey
processes.description: Staff are asked to complete monthly hours or activity surveys and reminders follow.
processes.trigger: survey sent

automation.idea: a reminder with survey steps
automation.why: responses come late

minutes_per_event.rationale: filling the survey and chasing responses

processes.name: Monthly cost allocation and RC charge review
processes.description: Allocation percentages and RC report charges are updated monthly; errors in files need correction.
processes.trigger: new month or plan change

automation.idea: a monthly allocation checklist
automation.why: files are reworked repeatedly

minutes_per_event.rationale: updating percentages and fixing file errors

processes.name: HR and budget questionnaires
processes.description: Managers complete salary surveys, budget questionnaires and performance reviewer lists on set deadlines.
processes.trigger: questionnaire or review cycle

automation.idea: a due-date checklist
automation.why: requirements repeat each cycle

minutes_per_event.rationale: gathering figures and filling forms

processes.name: Monthly volumetric explanation for investor relations
processes.description: Material wholesale volume changes are explained for Investor Relations each month on a deadline.
processes.trigger: monthly request

automation.idea: a reusable explanation template
automation.why: the same drivers are rewritten

minutes_per_event.rationale: comparing volumes and writing drivers

processes.name: Pipeline cut reporting
processes.description: Cuts from pipelines such as El Paso and PG&E are logged and reported so nominations are changed.
processes.trigger: pipeline cut notice

automation.idea: a cut-log template
automation.why: cuts are written up in free text

minutes_per_event.rationale: logging cuts and informing others

processes.name: Weekend on-call notes
processes.description: On-call staff log weekend gas control events and nomination changes for the desk.
processes.trigger: weekend on-call

automation.idea: an on-call notes template
automation.why: notes are rebuilt each weekend

minutes_per_event.rationale: summarizing weekend events

processes.name: Buyback and deficiency status review
processes.description: Industrial buyback deals are reviewed when plants have outages or do not take gas; status is chased and documentation awaited.
processes.trigger: plant outage or non-take

automation.idea: a checklist for outages and buyback treatment
automation.why: same questions each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: reviewing deals and contacting counterparties

processes.name: Application access approvals
processes.description: Automated requests ask the manager to approve access for staff to systems.
processes.trigger: access request

automation.idea: a standard approval criteria checklist
automation.why: each request is reviewed alike

minutes_per_event.rationale: reading and approving

processes.name: Sitara deal ticket correction and repathing
processes.description: Deal tickets with wrong entity, price or path are corrected and volumes repathed.
processes.trigger: incorrect ticket found

automation.idea: a correction checklist for ticket changes
automation.why: repath steps get missed

minutes_per_event.rationale: re-entering tickets and repathing

processes.name: Meeting scheduling and attendance confirmation
processes.description: Meetings are scheduled, rescheduled and attendance confirmed.
processes.trigger: meeting request

automation.idea: a standard meeting invite
automation.why: confirmations repeat

minutes_per_event.rationale: scheduling and confirming

processes.name: Customer meeting and trip planning
processes.description: Invitations, guest lists and RSVP forms are prepared for customer trips.
processes.trigger: annual customer event

automation.idea: an event checklist and invitation template
automation.why: steps repeat

minutes_per_event.rationale: compiling lists and forms

processes.name: Month-end close schedule
processes.description: Close timing and cut-off rules are communicated and supported.
processes.trigger: month-end or year-end close

automation.idea: a close calendar and reminder
automation.why: the same timeline repeats

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the schedule

processes.name: Deal extension or setup for meter flow without a deal
processes.description: Schedulers and volume management find meters that flowed with no deal or an expired deal and get the deal owner to extend, roll or create a deal covering the flow days so allocation exceptions clear.
processes.trigger: flow on a meter with no valid deal or outside deal dates, shown on an allocation exception
processes.output: extended or new deal covering the flow dates

automation.idea: a standard request to the deal owner with meter, flow dates and expired deal prefilled
automation.why: the same request is written by hand for each meter and followed up repeatedly

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up the meter and deal and writing the request to the deal owner

processes.merge_reason: same work of extending or creating a deal for a meter that flowed with no valid deal, in two date ranges

processes.name: Stranger's gas resolution
processes.description: Volume parked on Stranger's Gas for meters with no deal is sent to the deal owner for a deal, extension or write-off so the meter can be reallocated.
processes.trigger: meter volume allocated to Stranger's Gas after a missing or expired deal
processes.output: meter reallocated to a deal or contract, or approved write-off

automation.idea: a checklist and standard decision request listing meter, dates and options
automation.why: the same steps and follow-ups repeat for each meter

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the request and following up with the deal owner

processes.merge_reason: both resolve volume parked on Stranger's Gas by getting a deal assigned or a write-off decision

processes.name: Customer nomination files
processes.description: Daily or monthly nominations for plants and customers are exchanged by email as attachments, logged, passed on and revised when volumes change.
processes.trigger: new gas day or month nomination cycle, or a counterparty sending its file
processes.output: nomination sent or logged for scheduling

automation.idea: a standard nomination email with the attachment and period filled in
automation.why: the message is repeated with only dates and volumes changed

minutes_per_event.rationale: preparing the attachment and sending or logging it

processes.merge_reason: both are preparing or handling daily and monthly nomination files with customers

processes.name: Absence coverage handoff
processes.description: Before an absence or reassignment, a note names the backups who cover scheduling, confirmations and support and tells contacts.
processes.trigger: planned absence or reassignment

automation.idea: a coverage note template listing duties and backups
automation.why: each note repeats the same structure

minutes_per_event.rationale: listing duties and backups and sending the note

processes.merge_reason: both are handoff notes naming who covers duties during an absence

processes.name: Buyback and deficiency handling
processes.description: Schedulers decide buyback treatment, set up buyback paths and report status when customers do not take gas or plants are out.
processes.trigger: customer not taking gas or outage affecting a buyback

automation.idea: a buyback decision checklist with pathing rules
automation.why: decisions follow the same questions each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: checking the contract, deciding and writing the status

processes.name: Volume variance reconciliation with pipelines and intercompany
processes.description: Analysts compare HPL volumes with pipeline or intercompany counterparts, find missing sides, and correct deals or allocations. Replies and follow-ups stall it.
processes.trigger: variance or discrepancy found at an interconnect or intercompany deal

automation.idea: a variance log with a standard question to the counterpart
automation.why: each variance is chased with a new email

minutes_per_event.rationale: comparing figures, researching the missing side and writing the correction

processes.name: Transport and service rate clean-up
processes.description: Rates missing or wrong on transport usage tickets and service contracts are located and entered.
processes.trigger: missing service rates report or rate questions

automation.idea: a rate verification checklist against the rate matrix
automation.why: rates are checked by hand against the same sources

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up rates and re-entering them

processes.name: Unaccounted-for volume research
processes.description: Analysts research meters with unallocated or unaccounted-for volume across prior periods, with no deal or record in the systems.
processes.trigger: meter flow with no deal in OSS or CPR

automation.idea: a research checklist of systems to check per meter
automation.why: the same lookup sequence is repeated

minutes_per_event.rationale: searching several systems for history

processes.name: Counterparty and contract record maintenance
processes.description: Records for counterparties and contracts (names, DUNS, termination, Global entries) are updated after mergers or notices.
processes.trigger: name change, merger or termination notice

automation.idea: a change checklist covering Unify, Sitara and Global
automation.why: each change touches the same systems

minutes_per_event.rationale: updating records in multiple systems

processes.name: Producer volume and nomination revisions
processes.description: Producers or operations ask to change nominated volume at a meter or well because flow changed; the scheduler updates the nomination.
processes.trigger: producer flow change

automation.idea: a standard volume change email with meter and effective date
automation.why: each change repeats the same details

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing and entering the revised nomination

processes.name: Meter volume reallocation to the correct contract
processes.description: Volumes are moved between deals or contracts after misallocation. Corrections and follow-ups on who does the fix stall the work.
processes.trigger: volume allocated to the wrong contract or deal

automation.idea: a correction request form with from and to contract and months
automation.why: each correction needs the same fields

minutes_per_event.rationale: identifying the right contract and writing the correction

processes.name: Unpathed gas cleanup
processes.description: At period end schedulers list and assign unpathed deals, shippers and transport and chase open items.
processes.trigger: unpathed gas found at period end

automation.idea: an unpathed gas report with a daily open-items checklist
automation.why: the same list is rewritten and chased

minutes_per_event.rationale: listing unpathed items and chasing assignments

processes.name: Customer trip and meeting planning
processes.description: Planning customer trips and meetings with proposals, guest lists, invitations and RSVPs.
processes.trigger: customer trip or meeting planning cycle

automation.idea: an invitation and RSVP mailing template with a deadline checklist
automation.why: the same documents are produced each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: compiling guest lists and preparing the mailing

processes.name: Performance review reviewer selection
processes.description: Employees choose and submit reviewer lists for the performance system, with workarounds when the system fails.
processes.trigger: review cycle opens

automation.idea: a reviewer selection checklist with deadline reminders
automation.why: the same steps repeat each cycle

minutes_per_event.rationale: picking reviewers and sending the list

processes.name: Accounting arrangement setup for meters
processes.description: Logistics asks for accounting arrangements or tracking IDs so that production at a meter can be allocated and paid. Requests depend on the right deal numbers and sometimes wait for the deal owner.
processes.trigger: production flows at a meter with no accounting arrangement or contract

automation.idea: a standard request form capturing meter, months, contract and deal number
automation.why: requests are rebuilt from scratch with the same fields each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: gathering meter, month and deal numbers and writing the setup request

processes.name: Sitara ticket entry for new wells and production
processes.description: Deal makers and logistics request Sitara spot, baseload or committed reserves tickets when a well starts flowing or production is missing in the system. Committed reserves tickets wait on reserve forecasts.
processes.trigger: a well comes on line or production appears with no ticket

automation.idea: a ticket request form with meter, counterparty, price, dates and ticket type
automation.why: each request restates the same fields and corrections of price or dates follow

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the ticket request, correcting price or dates and passing the ticket number back

processes.name: HL&P flow numbers reporting
processes.description: The scheduler sends the latest HL&P flow numbers and monthly split to the commercial contact on request.
processes.trigger: request for the latest HL&P flow numbers

automation.idea: a standard weekly send of the flow numbers workbook
automation.why: the same attachment is sent repeatedly

minutes_per_event.rationale: pulling the numbers and attaching them

processes.name: Producer meter shut-in and restore notices
processes.description: Field operations shut in meters for repairs, pigging, tie-ins or off-spec gas and notify schedulers and producers; restoring waits for repairs.
processes.trigger: leak, pigging, tie-in, off-spec gas or free liquids at a meter
processes.output: meter shut in notice, later restored

automation.idea: a shut-in notice template with meter, reason, expected restore and producer contact
automation.why: notices repeat the same facts

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the notice and notifying the people affected

processes.name: Monthly cost allocation percentages
processes.description: Management and analysts update plan and monthly allocation percentages by group; corrections and reworked spreadsheets are common.
processes.trigger: monthly or plan allocation request

automation.idea: a locked allocation spreadsheet template with a sum check
automation.why: errors and re-sent files repeat each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: reworking percentages and fixing sheet errors

processes.name: System access request approval
processes.description: Managers get automated requests to approve access to deal and scheduling systems.
processes.trigger: access request submitted for an employee

automation.idea: a short checklist of the access criteria for approval
automation.why: approvals follow the same rules

minutes_per_event.rationale: reading the request and confirming the need

processes.name: Annual budget and staffing submission
processes.description: Managers supply budget questionnaires, staff lists, training needs and staffing for review.
processes.trigger: annual budget cycle

automation.idea: a budget input checklist with staff and class lists prefilled
automation.why: inputs are gathered by hand

minutes_per_event.rationale: collecting staff and training data and filling forms

processes.name: Plant election and processing notice recording
processes.description: The desk records monthly plant elections such as ethane keep-whole shrinkage and sends processing notices.
processes.trigger: monthly plant election window

automation.idea: a standard election notice with the shrinkage and fuel fields prefilled
automation.why: the notice is the same each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: writing the notice and confirming figures

processes.name: Blue Dolphin invoice and volume responsibility routing
processes.description: Questions on which entity owns Blue Dolphin volumes and invoices are resolved by pathing volumes and routing invoices to the right party. Follow-ups are needed.
processes.trigger: Blue Dolphin monthly invoice or volume question
processes.output: confirmed responsible entity and routed invoice

automation.idea: a standing routing instruction for each invoice type
automation.why: the same question is re-asked each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: researching responsibility and writing updates

processes.name: Sitara deal cleanup and bankruptcy book moves
processes.description: Large batches of deals are killed, zeroed or moved to other books, and teams check the impact on pathing and volume management.
processes.trigger: contract termination or deal cleanup decision
processes.output: deals zeroed or moved with lists sent to teams

automation.idea: a checklist for zeroing instead of killing with a list of affected paths
automation.why: the same impact checks are repeated

minutes_per_event.rationale: building deal lists and checking path impacts

processes.name: Transport usage ticket setup and rate update
processes.description: Each month transport usage tickets are set up or copied, rates refreshed and volumes attached and checked across pipes. Third-party rates and baseload agreements are awaited from others.
processes.trigger: start of a new gas month
processes.output: updated transport usage tickets with current rates and volumes

automation.idea: a monthly checklist of tickets to copy forward, rates to refresh and reports to run
automation.why: the same steps repeat each month and are tracked from memory

minutes_per_event.rationale: re-entering rates, copying prior tickets and checking volumes by pipe

processes.name: Monthly activity and hours survey completion
processes.description: Staff are asked each month to complete activity and hours surveys for the operations performance process. Responses are slow and reminders are needed.
processes.trigger: monthly survey distribution
processes.output: completed survey returned by the due date

automation.idea: a prefilled survey from last month's allocations with a reminder email
automation.why: answers are largely the same each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: selecting activities, entering hours and responding to reminders

processes.name: Monthly volumetric variance explanation
processes.description: Business reporting asks for verification of wholesale volumes and explanations of material month, quarter and year changes, due on a fixed day.
processes.trigger: monthly request from reporting for volumetric analysis
processes.output: verified volumes and written variance explanations

automation.idea: a variance table prefilled with changes over the threshold and a column for reasons
automation.why: figures are looked up by hand each month

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up volume changes and writing explanations

processes.name: Price and invoice discrepancy check against deal record
processes.description: Counterparty invoices or statements that differ from the deal price, volume or entity are checked against the deal system, then the price is corrected or the discrepancy is explained. Resolution often stalls with unanswered requests and escalation.
processes.trigger: counterparty invoice or statement disagrees with the deal record
processes.output: corrected deal price or confirmed explanation

automation.idea: a discrepancy checklist and request that pulls invoice and deal price side by side
automation.why: each case repeats the same lookups and questions

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up the deal and invoice and writing follow-up messages

processes.name: Daily gas control and pipeline cut reporting
processes.description: Desk members report pipeline cuts, outages and weekend gas control events, then update meter volumes and nominations. Follow-ups verify that meters were updated.
processes.trigger: pipeline cut call or weekend gas control event
processes.output: logged cuts and updated nominations or volumes

automation.idea: a weekend log of cuts, meters and nomination changes
automation.why: the same events are rewritten in prose each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: typing out cuts and meter changes and updating the records
